findings: EnabledDebugList has an actual initially false category array; Parse obtains NODE_DEBUG_NATIVE through credentials::SafeGetenv before parsing. The global per_process list and each Environment list are separate owners.

Parse copies its incoming text, repeatedly lowercases the comma-delimited wanted component, and tests it as a substring of every static lowercased category name. It only enables flags. An empty component within a nonempty comma list therefore matches all category names; an initially empty input does not enter the loop.
FSPermission debug uses the global per_process list. Its explicit gate and the delegated Debug gate are separate reads. This is distinct from the trace_events category/controller owner.

Debug formatting and FWrite are real native allocation/output paths. A std::string argument copies under ToStringOrStringView; const char* arguments remain views. On Windows stdout/stderr console output performs actual UTF-8 conversion and WriteConsoleW, with fwrite fallback.

Addon/child-process/inspector/WASI/worker policies each contain the original deny_all_ Boolean, Apply sets it true and is_granted returns its negation. The original value-initialized construction must be preserved; an uninitialized raw allocation is not equivalent.
open_boundaries: Permission implementation, process-level/Environment debug ownership and native allocation-domain initialization remain to be authored and peer reviewed.
Original FSPermission directory-stat early-return cleanup and wildcard-descendant destructor behavior are separately reported to Root; this proof does not silently correct or qualify them.
